name: Joypad-OS Steam Input Gamepad
notes: 179-byte descriptor. Source: joypad-ai/joypad-os sinput_descriptors.h at 9fa79f45. Steam Input compatible mode: 32 buttons, 4x 16-bit axes, 2x 16-bit axes, 1x 32-bit axis, 6x 16-bit gyro/accel axes, vendor data. Answers SDL's features command (output report 0x03 03 02) with the 64-byte input report 0x02 joypad-os sends with no pad attached (sinput_mode.c sinput_build_feature_response), the last serial byte the controller's index. OutputDecoded carries leftMotor and rightMotor from a type 2 haptics write and lightbarRed, lightbarGreen and lightbarBlue from an RGB write, the commands joypad-os handles.

layout.note: Pico-stack gamepad firmware (RP2040 VID 2E8A) presenting Steam Input. Hobbyist firmware with no published spec apart from its descriptor.
